lead7: Lead month 7 is not in the CDS monthly product (leads 1–6). Forecast: the same SEAS5 run's sub-daily fields (seasonal-original), averaged over the month the way the monthly product is (instantaneous fields: every step from 00 UTC on the 1st to the last step before the next month; accumulations: the month's total over its seconds). Hindcast reference: the same 1993–2016 hindcast, 25 members, from the daily copy of the C3S archive on AWS (instantaneous fields, interpolated to the CDS grid) and the CDS sub-daily hindcast (accumulations, 50 hPa height, 30/50 hPa wind). Skill is lower at lead 7, and the products apply the same calibration and significance tests to it as to leads 1–6.

index_meta.label: Relative Niño-3.4
index_meta.note: Niño-3.4 minus the 20°S–20°N tropical mean, RONI-scaled by calendar month

index_meta.label: Trans-Niño index
index_meta.note: standardised Niño-1+2 minus standardised Niño-4: positive means east-loaded

index_meta.label: PDO
index_meta.note: North Pacific EOF projection on the NCEI scale, global mean removed

index_meta.label: AMO (relative)
index_meta.note: North Atlantic 0–60°N minus the 60°S–60°N global mean
